statement: There are rational tensor polynomials f, Ujk, Klijk, Ml, Pl in A, p, g, δ, with the following properties. They are equivariant under orthogonal changes of coordinates, with f invariant. Their coefficients are specified by Table I in Appendix A, using the decoding in Section 6.1. Put Clijk = Klijk − Kiljk, Glijk = δliUjk + Clijk. For every choice of the data above with χ ≥ 0, I := z2 [5UjkAjk + Clijk(δljAik + δlkAij) − 4f] + [DlGlijk + (2a − 1)qlGlijk] Xijk + w [DlMl + (2a + 1)qlMl] + z [DlPl + 2aqlPl] + f|ℓ|2 − (Dlf + 2aqlf)ℓl ≥ ϵ∗(z2 + |ℓ|2 ). (4.3) In particular, f ≥ ϵ∗ whenever g2 + |p|2 ≤ 1. For every symmetric trace-free unit matrix A and vector p satisfying g = 0, |p| = 1, Ap = λp, λ < 0, define S0 = λA − A2 , Vijk = pi(S0)jk + pj(S0)ki + pk(S0)ij + pipjpk. Then S := −λf + Ujk(S0 + p ⊗ p)jk + ClijkplVijk + plMl ≥ δ∗. (4.4) Moreover, U and K are even in p, and P = 0 when g = 0.
